title: UDP: Fix more conversations over UDP
description:
The commit 387d88bc1711c279e587fcab8799e198deb9dfcb
introduced serious side effects on protocols related to RTP.

The deinterlacing strategy requires expanding the conversations
API, and an update of RTP dissectors (RTP, RTCP, RTSP).

See #18122

Notes for the reviewer:
- the API for managing the deinterlacing strategy was extended in order to handle more cases (new functions `_xtd()` , new functions `_strat()`, and more cases in `find_conversation_deinterlaced()` )
- new EXACT_EXCLUDED option to be able to find only wildcarded conversations that need their dissector to be applied to a non-wildcarded conversation (maybe to be renamed to NO_EXACT)
- numerous updates to RTP related stuff to take into account the above changes, also TCP and TFTP (which was the first goal with the previous MR)
- further work in a one or more later MRs (isolation of the deinterlacing support in a dedicated function, identification of related frames, wider use of this deinterlacing stuff if results are good, more documentation)
